insane--adj.ex: Driving in that storm was insane.

signal--noun.def: A sign or a sound that gives information.
signal--noun.ex: The phone signal is weak here.

shake--verb.def: To move quickly from side to side.
shake--verb.ex: His hands shook from the cold.

naked--adj.ex: The baby was naked on the towel.

damage--noun.def: Physical harm that makes something less useful.

damage--verb.def: To harm something so that it works less well.

amount--noun.def: How much of something there is.
amount--noun.ex: Add a small amount of salt.

safety--noun.def: The state of being free from danger.

block--verb.def: To stop something from passing or happening.
block--verb.ex: A fallen tree blocked the road.

fancy--noun.def: A liking for something, often a passing one.
fancy--noun.ex: He took a fancy to the old clock.

fancy--verb.def: To want something, in British informal English.
fancy--verb.ex: Do you fancy a cup of tea?
fancy--verb.exTr: Canın bir bardak çay çeker mi?

dig--verb.def: To make a hole in the ground.
dig--verb.ex: They dug a well behind the house.

funeral--noun.def: The ceremony held when someone is buried.

theory--noun.def: An explanation that scientists have tested.

hidden--adj.def: Kept out of sight, or not easy to notice.
hidden--adj.ex: There are hidden costs in the contract.

personally--adv.def: Speaking for yourself, or doing something yourself.
personally--adv.ex: Personally, I prefer the older design.
personally--adv.exTr: Şahsen ben eski tasarımı tercih ederim.

artist--noun.def: A person who creates art such as paintings.
artist--noun.ex: The artist works in a small studio.

barely--adv.def: Only just, almost not at all.
barely--adv.ex: I could barely hear her voice.

legal--adj.def: Allowed by law, or relating to the law.

dating--noun.def: The activity of going out with someone romantically.

loss--noun.def: The fact of no longer having something.
loss--noun.ex: The company reported a small loss.

connection--noun.def: A link between two things or people.

assistant--noun.def: A person whose job is to help someone else.

rush--verb.def: To move or act very quickly.

rough--adj.ex: The wall has a rough surface.

murderer--noun.def: A person who has killed someone on purpose.

obvious--adj.ex: The answer was obvious to everyone.

goodness--interj.def: Said when you are surprised or shocked.

ruin--noun.def: A destroyed building, or complete destruction.

tongue--noun.def: The soft part inside your mouth used for tasting.
tongue--noun.ex: He burnt his tongue on the soup.

cancer--noun.def: A serious disease in which cells grow wrongly.

ocean--noun.def: One of the very large areas of sea on Earth.
ocean--noun.ex: The ocean was calm that morning.

liar--noun.def: A person who does not tell the truth.

tour--verb.def: To travel around a place or give shows in many places.
tour--verb.ex: The band toured Europe last spring.
tour--verb.exTr: Grup geçen ilkbahar Avrupa turnesine çıktı.

plant--verb.def: To put a seed or a young tree into the ground.

bless--verb.def: To ask God to protect someone.
bless--verb.ex: The imam blessed the new house.

warning--noun.def: Something that tells you about a possible danger.
warning--noun.ex: The label carries a clear warning.

crash--noun.def: An accident in which a vehicle hits something.

crash--verb.def: To hit something violently, or to stop working suddenly.

defense--noun.def: Protection against attack, or an argument in support.
defense--noun.ex: The team has a strong defense.

complicated--adj.def: Having many parts and hard to understand.

shape--verb.def: To give something a form, or to influence how it develops.

priest--noun.def: A man who leads religious services in a church.

downstairs--adj.def: On a lower floor of a building.

burning--adj.ex: Smoke rose from the burning field.

giant--adj.ex: A giant wave hit the boat.

insurance--noun.def: An agreement that pays you if something bad happens.

scare--verb.ex: The loud bang scared the horses.

horn--noun.def: The hard point on an animal's head, or a car's warning device.

eventually--adv.def: After a long time or after many problems.
eventually--adv.ex: They eventually agreed on a price.

ashamed--adj.def: Feeling bad because of something you did.
ashamed--adj.ex: He was ashamed of his temper.

assume--verb.def: To accept something as true without proof.
assume--verb.ex: I assumed the shop was closed.

rise--noun.def: An increase in amount, or an upward movement.
rise--noun.ex: There was a sharp rise in rents.

rise--verb.def: To move upwards, or to become greater.

request--verb.def: To ask for something politely or formally.

positive--adj.def: Good and hopeful, or showing that something is present.

location--noun.ex: The shop has a good location.

useless--adj.exTr: Bu eski şarj aleti işe yaramaz.

grant--noun.def: Money given by an official body for a purpose.

grant--verb.def: To officially give someone what they asked for.

deliver--verb.def: To take goods or letters to a place.

switch--noun.def: The small part you press to turn power on or off.
switch--noun.ex: The switch is behind the door.

switch--verb.def: To change from one thing to another.
switch--verb.ex: We switched to a cheaper supplier.

grave--noun.def: The place in the ground where a dead person lies.
grave--noun.ex: They left flowers on the grave.

chase--noun.def: The act of running after someone to catch them.
chase--noun.ex: The chase ended near the bridge.

suffer--verb.def: To experience pain or something unpleasant.
suffer--verb.ex: Many farmers suffered from the drought.

bang--verb.def: To hit something and make a loud noise.

poison--noun.def: A substance that can kill or harm you.

wound--noun.def: An injury where the skin is cut or broken.

courage--noun.def: The ability to face danger or pain.
courage--noun.ex: It took courage to speak up.

hunt--noun.def: The activity of chasing animals, or a search.
hunt--noun.ex: The hunt for the missing dog continued.

hunt--verb.def: To chase animals to kill them, or to search hard.

disease--noun.def: An illness that affects a person, animal or plant.

council--noun.def: A group elected to manage a town or an organization.
council--noun.ex: The city council approved the plan.

threat--noun.def: A warning that something bad may happen.
threat--noun.ex: Pollution is a threat to the lake.

victory--noun.def: Success in a game, an election or a war.
victory--noun.ex: It was their first victory this season.
